response.sql:
WITH account_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id,
         c.town_city,
         COUNT(ft.transaction_id) AS transaction_count
  FROM Accounts AS a
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
town_counts AS (
  SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_transaction_count
  FROM account_counts
  GROUP BY town_city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT ac.account_id,
         ac.town_city,
         ac.transaction_count,
         1.0 * ac.transaction_count / NULLIF(tc.town_transaction_count, 0) AS town_transaction_share,
         1.0 * ac.transaction_count / NULLIF(AVG(ac.transaction_count) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_average
  FROM account_counts AS ac
  JOIN town_counts AS tc ON tc.town_city = ac.town_city
)
SELECT account_id, town_city, transaction_count, town_transaction_share, ratio_to_average
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean transaction count across all accounts whose holder is on file and has a non-NULL town; accounts with no transactions count as zero. Town transaction shares use those same eligible accounts, and a zero-count town has a NULL share.
